name: prana
description: Choose, compare, and conduct short Prana breathwork sessions with conservative general-wellness guidance.

interface.shortDescription: Choose and conduct short breathing practices
interface.longDescription: Prana brings its public breathwork catalog and deterministic guided-session protocol into ChatGPT and Codex. Compare breathing techniques, choose a conservative practice from explicit preferences, conduct a short text or voice-guided session in a compatible host, or open the matching session in the Prana app. This release is anonymous and does not access account history, mood, biometrics, subscriptions, or private health data.
